shared_schema.input: Exact-key JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic_fixture=true, profile.priority (quality/maintenance/production), ERP/MES-style work_order, embedded time-series telemetry_csv, inspections, maintenance_logs.
shared_schema.telemetry: CSV header asset_id,timestamp,metric,value,unit. Temperature degC and vibration mm/s both required. Per-metric timestamps strictly increasing and timezone-aware.
shared_schema.inspection: id, work_order_id, asset_id, timestamp, inspector_id, characteristic, value, unit, decision, rationale. Chronological decisions must agree with inclusive tolerance bounds.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic_fixture, work_order_id, asset_id, priority, initial_facts, recommendations, journey, human_escalation, evidence, limitations. Errors: schema_version, status=error, error; exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate gate checks identities, traceability, schema, finite values, units, tolerances, physical ranges and chronology. Shared validate_journey checks action prerequisites and exactly two steps.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated work order, quality inspection records and normalized telemetry become prerequisite facts.
Priority-aware discovery selects one eligible first action; safety and quality gates override user preference.
Planner validates the two-step chain using explicitly planned effects; second step remains conditional on first-step completion.
Evidence retains quality decision provenance, tolerance, selected inspection ID, alert rows and invented maintenance logs.

behavior.synthetic_data: Fictitious IDs, invented maintenance log, physically plausible sensor series. synthetic_fixture(seed) provides reproducible randomized telemetry.
behavior.safety: Any critical reading (temperature >=85 degC or vibration >=12 mm/s) selects human escalation followed by safety-hold recommendation. Escalation is required but not delivered by this offline planner.
behavior.warning: Temperature >=70 degC or vibration >=7 mm/s prioritizes maintenance when quality passes.
behavior.traceability: Demonstrative ISO 9001-style traceability retains decision, actor, time, work-order/asset links, measurement, tolerance and rationale; no certification claim.
behavior.quality: Missing inspection schedules inspection and reviewer assignment; failed latest inspection triggers nonconformance investigation and reinspection; passing inspection permits human release-review planning.
behavior.units: Temperature range [-40,200] degC; vibration [0,100] mm/s; diameter (0,1000] mm. Invalid or nonfinite values rejected.
behavior.side_effects: Plans only; never releases a work order, changes machinery, sends alerts or claims completion.
